entries.name: Canonize the Outcome
entries.effect: Enter what just happened into the record as official. Target: Soul defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Imposed — their next roll is made 3d10 keep-lowest, because contradicting the minutes is expensive.
entries.flavor: A rubber stamp comes down somewhere nobody can see. The ink is already dry.
entries.concept: One outcome made official; contradiction now costs.
entries.mechanicalHook: Imposed on a failed Soul defense: the target's next roll takes the worse result.
entries.targetText: One creature whose last success or failure you intend to make permanent.
entries.riskText: Canonize the wrong thing and the record will hold you to it too.
entries.signature: A line of gray-gold minutes writes itself in the air behind the target.

entries.name: Contain the Breach
entries.effect: Box the incident inside procedure. Target: Body defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Restrained for 1 round — paperwork has a perimeter, and they are standing inside it.
entries.flavor: Four lines of light draw a square on the floor. Nobody drew them. Everybody obeys them.
entries.concept: A procedural perimeter around one breach.
entries.mechanicalHook: Restrained for 1 round on a failed Body defense.
entries.targetText: One creature, construct, or spill of something that should not be spreading.
entries.riskText: A contained breach is not a resolved one; the clock on it is now yours.
entries.signature: Hazard-tape light, humming faintly, at exactly the height of the knee.

entries.name: Edit the Record
entries.effect: Amend the minutes so the target was always on your side. Target: Mind defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Charmed for 1 round — they remember agreeing with you, and they are fairly sure they meant it.
entries.flavor: A pen scratch in a book that is not open. The target blinks, and the blink has a footnote.
entries.concept: A small amendment to what the target remembers agreeing to.
entries.mechanicalHook: Charmed for 1 round on a failed Mind defense.
entries.targetText: One creature who can hear you and has a memory worth editing.
entries.riskText: Edits leave marks. A Records Pactkeeper who reads the margin will know your hand.
entries.signature: The target's shadow nods a half-second before they do.

entries.name: Erase Concept
entries.effect: Strike one word from the target's reality — a name, a plan, the thing they were about to reach for. Target: Mind defense vs Cast DC. On fail: 1d6 psychic damage to Stress as the concept tears out with its roots.
entries.flavor: A black bar falls across a word only the target can see. The word was load-bearing.
entries.concept: Surgical removal of one idea, briefly.
entries.mechanicalHook: 1d6 psychic Stress on a failed Mind defense.
entries.targetText: One creature holding a word, a plan, or a certainty.
entries.riskText: Concepts grow back. Sometimes they grow back angry.
entries.signature: The air where the word was goes briefly, politely blank.

entries.name: File the Incident
entries.effect: Open a file on the target. The file is looking at them. Target: Soul defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Shaken for 1 round — it is very hard to be brave in triplicate.
entries.flavor: A manila folder nobody is holding opens to a page with their name on it.
entries.concept: The weight of being officially noticed.
entries.mechanicalHook: Shaken for 1 round on a failed Soul defense.
entries.targetText: One creature who has done something, or is about to.
entries.riskText: Files are permanent. The Long Quiet keeps copies.
entries.signature: A reference number appears over the target's head, legible only to clerks and gods.

entries.name: Invoke Civic Authority
entries.effect: Stand down. You have been served. Target: Soul defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Compelled for 1 round — they carry out the one plain instruction you give as the sigil lands (drop it, kneel, step back, be quiet).
entries.flavor: Your voice acquires a seal. The seal acquires a bailiff.
entries.concept: One lawful instruction, enforced by mandate rather than muscle.
entries.mechanicalHook: Compelled for 1 round on a failed Soul defense; the instruction must be one plain sentence.
entries.targetText: One creature within the sound of your voice.
entries.riskText: Authority spent outside your Jurisdiction is Noise. Invoke it where you are licensed.
entries.signature: Gray-gold letters of a warrant hang in the air for one breath.

entries.name: Precedent Lock
entries.effect: Every step the target takes must now match the last one. Target: Body defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Staggered for 1 round — movement halved, −2 to attacks, because improvisation has been ruled out of order.
entries.flavor: Their footprints repeat themselves. The second set is slightly wrong.
entries.concept: Consistency enforced on a body that wanted to be clever.
entries.mechanicalHook: Staggered for 1 round on a failed Body defense.
entries.riskText: Precedent cuts both ways: lock a pattern you share and you share the lock.
entries.signature: A faint ledger-line follows the target's heels.

entries.name: Reassign Authority
entries.effect: The floor is no longer theirs. Target: Body defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Prone — the ground read the memo before they did.
entries.flavor: A chair is pulled out from under a reality that was sitting on it.
entries.concept: Standing is revoked, briefly and literally.
entries.mechanicalHook: Prone on a failed Body defense.
entries.targetText: One creature currently holding the floor, the high ground, or the room.
entries.riskText: Reassigning authority you do not hold is a breach. The record notices.

entries.name: Redact Entity
entries.effect: Drop a black bar over the target's eyes. Target: Mind defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Blinded for 1 round — the world is still there; it has simply been classified.
entries.flavor: A censor's bar, matte black, hovering exactly where their sight line was.
entries.concept: One creature's perception redacted for one round.
entries.mechanicalHook: Blinded for 1 round on a failed Mind defense.
entries.targetText: One creature that is looking at something you would rather it did not.
entries.riskText: Redactions are logged. Someone with clearance will eventually read what you hid.
entries.signature: The bar reads [REDACTED] in a typeface older than the Shattering.

entries.name: Restore the Quiet
entries.effect: Return the Long Quiet to one creature. Target: Soul defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Calmed for 1 round — the violence in them is filed, not felt. A willing ally may simply decline the defense.
entries.flavor: The room's noise floor drops a notch. Somewhere a fluorescent light stops buzzing.
entries.concept: Institutional calm delivered to one person.
entries.mechanicalHook: Calmed for 1 round on a failed Soul defense (allies may decline the save).
entries.targetText: One creature too loud for the moment — a panicking ally, a raging foe.
entries.riskText: Quiet imposed on grief is not healing. It is a hold.
entries.signature: A hush with the texture of a closed door.

entries.name: Rewrite the Draft
entries.effect: Send the target's next action back for revision. Target: Mind defense vs Cast DC. On fail: Staggered for 1 round — movement halved, −2 to attacks, while they reconsider the wording.
entries.flavor: A red pencil hovers over the next thing they were going to do.
entries.mechanicalHook: Staggered for 1 round on a failed Mind defense.
entries.riskText: Drafts you return may come back better.
entries.signature: Marginalia flickers at the edge of the target's vision: see me.

entries.name: Semantic Cut
entries.effect: Cut the meaning out of one word the target is standing on — their title, their threat, their name for you. Target: Soul defense vs Cast DC. On fail: 1d6 psychic damage to Stress as the word goes hollow under them.
entries.flavor: A clean incision through a sentence. The sentence keeps talking; it no longer means anything.
entries.concept: Meaning removed from one load-bearing word.
entries.mechanicalHook: 1d6 psychic Stress on a failed Soul defense.
entries.targetText: One creature whose words are doing work.
entries.riskText: Words heal slower than skin. Cut carefully.
entries.signature: The word hangs in the air a moment, unglossed, then falls.

entries.name: Stabilize Narrative
entries.effect: Hold one ally's story steady. Target: Soul defense vs Cast DC — a willing ally simply declines it. On fail (or on consent): Calmed for 1 round — panic, fear, and chaos have to apply in writing, and the office is closed.
entries.flavor: You put a hand on the moment and it stops shaking.
entries.concept: One ally's thread held against fear and chaos.
entries.mechanicalHook: Calmed for 1 round; the engine posts a Soul save card, which a willing ally declines (the GM applies the state).
entries.targetText: One ally whose story is about to come apart.
entries.riskText: A stabilized narrative is a loan from the Long Quiet. It comes due.
entries.signature: A hairline of gray-gold runs along the ally's silhouette, like a binding thread.
